links.outcome: Discrimination and calibration of LLM uncertainty proxies (verbalized confidence, token probability, sample consistency) for diagnosis and treatment
links.effect: Sample consistency by sentence embedding had the best discrimination (ROC AUC 0.68-0.79) but poor calibration. SC by GPT annotation had ROC AUC 0.66-0.74 with accurate calibration. Verbalized confidence consistently overestimated confidence.
links.quote: SC by sentence embedding achieved the highest discriminative performance (ROC AUC 0.68-0.79), yet with poor calibration.

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark evaluating uncertainty estimation methods (sample consistency, token probabilities, verbalized confidence) for LLMs on medical diagnosis and treatment datasets to quantify confidence for physician users.
